subject: Re: Greenpoint evidence sampling & proof-chain mapping
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@greenpointhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence sampling request for upcoming SOC 2 review

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Greenpoint's audit team is doing a targeted sampling for our SOC 2 refresh and we'd like to pull a small set of artifacts from Redwood to validate controls related to: access provisioning, S3 possession of keys/evidence, and key rotation timelines (SOC2 CC6/CC7 coverage + CAIQ sections).

Our ask is narrow: can you provide an evidence sample package that includes:
- A manifest listing object keys / S3 paths and timestamps for 3 representative artifacts (logs, config snapshots, proof-of-possession pdfs)
- The KMS rotation log or signed statement of key IDs and rotation dates
- A short chain-of-custody note (who uploaded, by which service account) for each item

We prefer pre-signed S3 links or a temporary bucket ACL for the audit window (48-72 hours). Attach a minimal PDF of the SOC/CAIQ mapping if you have one.

Can you confirm feasibility and an estimated delivery window? Also include the name of the person on your side who will be the primary contact for the handoff.

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
Sr. Information Security Manager
Greenpoint Health

---
Attachment: greenpoint-soc2-req-2027.pdf (requested checklist template)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@greenpointhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence sampling request for upcoming SOC 2 review

Hi Alicia,

Appreciate the clear scope. We can do a scoped sampling instead of a full export to reduce friction for your auditors. Proposed plan:
1) We'll select three representative artifacts across the buckets you noted (audit-log snippet, config snapshot, signed possession PDF).
2) We'll generate an s3-proof-manifest.csv with object keys, upload timestamps, uploader service account, and a sha256 checksum for each file.
3) We'll include an excerpted KMS rotation log (redacted principals) and a short chain-of-custody note signed by our Compliance lead.
4) Delivery: pre-signed links valid for 72 hours. Target: 48 hours after you confirm which CAIQ sections you'd like prioritized (access controls vs. key mgmt).

Questions for you: which CAIQ domains should we prioritize if you only want the top two? Also confirm whether your auditors need MD5 or SHA256 checksums (we provide sha256 by default).

Primary contact on our side will be Ben Carter (cc'd) for manifest & transfer, and Marissa for compliance sign-off. If that works we'll proceed and aim to share the manifest + links within two business days.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-manifest-template.csv (blank template we'll fill)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@greenpointhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence sampling request for upcoming SOC 2 review

Looping in a short note on KMS: our KMS rotation is automated with KMS-key IDs and rotation events logged to an internal audit trail. For the sample package we'll export the rotation entries tied to the object keys in the manifest and include a signed verification statement.

Action items (from our side):
- I'll produce kms-rotation-log.txt (redacted) showing key IDs + rotation dates relevant to the sample objects.
- We'll compute and include sha256 checksums in s3-proof-manifest.csv.
- Marissa will provide a signed chain-of-custody note after we assemble the artifacts.

Ben
Sr. Systems Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: kms-rotation-log.txt (redacted sample)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@greenpointhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence sampling request for upcoming SOC 2 review

Hi Alicia — thanks, team.

Quick status: we assembled the three sample artifacts, generated the manifest and the rotation excerpt, and attached the two items below. Delivery notes:
- s3-proof-manifest.csv (attached) — includes object keys, upload timestamps, uploader identity (service-account-redwood-ingest), and sha256 checksums.
- kms-rotation-log.txt (attached) — redacted key IDs and rotation entries.
- Pre-signed S3 links: (sent via separate secure message) — valid for 72 hours from 2027-05-06T16:00:00-07:00.

Next steps:
- Please confirm your auditor's preferred checksum type (sha256 is in the manifest).
- If you need extended access beyond 72 hours we can do a scheduled, time-boxed bucket ACL for the audit window; that would require an SOX/contract note which Marissa will draft.
- Proposed handoff call: Friday 2027-05-07 10:00 AM PT — I've created a tentative calendar invite (link below).

Thanks — feel free to reply if anything is missing.

Jasmine Liu
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: s3-proof-manifest.csv, kms-rotation-log.txt
Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=gp-evidence-handoff
